Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: Magnifique ! I remember reading about that disaster during mes études.

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: Wiped out humans' most advanced civilisation just like that, oui ? It is hard to imagine that some groups managed to survive anyway, when so many around them had fallen.

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: But it is good that votre famille got out of it. It is why we have you with us, non ?

Line.Text: Nothing so dramatic has happened to mine, just--
